title: Fresh WordPress Setup
description: Essential first steps after installing WordPress — site identity, timezone, permalinks, and sample content cleanup.

steps.title: Set Site Title, Tagline & Language
steps.instructions: Update site title and tagline under Settings → General. Set the correct timezone and date format for your audience.

steps.title: Enable Pretty Permalinks
steps.instructions: Choose Post name (/%postname%/) under Settings → Permalinks unless your host requires a custom structure.

steps.title: Remove Sample Content
steps.instructions: Delete the Hello World post, Sample Page, and default comment. Replace or remove the default Twenty* theme if unused.

steps.title: Upload Site Icon & Logo
steps.instructions: Add a favicon via Appearance → Customize → Site Identity. Confirm it appears in browser tabs and mobile bookmarks.

steps.title: Configure Comments & Discussion
steps.instructions: Decide whether comments are enabled site-wide. Set moderation rules and disable pingbacks if not needed.

steps.title: Secure the Admin Account
steps.instructions: Use a strong password and a non-obvious username (not 'admin'). Add a real email address for password resets.

steps.title: Block Search Engines on Staging
steps.instructions: On non-production environments, check 'Discourage search engines' under Settings → Reading until launch day.
